algorithms.label: Global-QEA
algorithms.name: qea
algorithms.parameter_basis: Global conditional-thermometer QEA adaptation; n=30 matches GA population. Rotation=0.01*pi, probability floor=0.01; exploratory defaults, not tuned. Matched controls share initialization, decoding, elite path and evaluation budget; classical update rate=0.05, random has no update. Han & Kim 2002 DOI:10.1109/TEVC.2002.804320.
